description:
Lists the public holidays of a year in Germany, nationwide or for one of the 16 federal states including state-specific holidays (rules as of 2026-08-15). Intended for requests where the user asks which public holidays fall in a year or month in a given state. Key output fields: datum (ISO date), name (German), bundesweit (boolean). Working days between dates are counted by count_working_days.

Example user questions: "Welche Feiertage gibt es 2026 in Bayern?"; "Feiertage in Berlin auflisten"; "Welche gesetzlichen Feiertage hat Sachsen?"; "Gibt es im Oktober 2026 Feiertage in NRW?"

land.description: 2-letter federal state code. Omit for nationwide-only holidays.

name: list_public_holidays
title: Feiertage auflisten
